guard: static retirement reap proves exit via pinned record when disk record is absent and fails closed when unadopted
why: The clean-despawn cell verifies that when the custodian unlinks its on-disk record, the pinned record proves exit so deprovisioning completes.
The survivor cell verifies that when a custodian is killed while the child survives, static retirement signals and reaps the live child and its group before freeing the alias.
The unadopted cell verifies that an absent record with no pinned record fails closed with RuntimeReapUnproven.

mutations.name: M1 omit pinned record fallback in CustodialPtyRuntime.reap
mutations.find:
const pinnedRecord = this.records.get(reference.id);
    const evidence = await reapSeat(this.root, reference.id, { pinnedRecord });
mutations.expectRed: clean1 dm_local- durable gone after despawn
mutations.cell: clean1 dm_local- durable gone after despawn
mutations.note: Without the pinned record fallback, when the custodian unlinks its on-disk record upon clean exit, reapSeat returns absent and requireRuntimeReap throws RuntimeReapUnproven, failing deprovisioning.
